scope: Engineering feasibility under explicit assumptions. Inverting a plotted curve does not identify the author's noise model. Passing an improved-SNR case is not a reproduction of the paper's 35 dB experiment.

inverse.note: 7 ns is a rounded diagnostic inferred from all digitized Fig.6 STD values, not an independent prediction or author setting. Pixel ranges are reading uncertainty, not sampling confidence.

frontend.case_selection: 80 dB chosen before this run: the previous 100 Hz model's 110-fold STD gap implies about 41 dB additional input SNR; 80 dB adds margin. This explicitly changes the paper's stated 35 dB. Threshold 0.0001 A0 reduces deterministic FID threshold bias; it is an idealized assumption, not a hardware claim.
frontend.filter: Same causal Butterworth bandpass on signal and noise; zero initial state. SNR is initial unfiltered sine RMS divided by lowpass-noise RMS before bandpass.
frontend.statistics: Evaluate complete windows at fixed scheduled ends, separated by 50 ms. Bootstrap independent whole acquisitions, not overlapping frames. Report both floating and nearest-microhertz outputs, all record faults, and noiseless bias.
frontend.acceptance: For each digitized window, 97.5 percentile bootstrap upper bound of STD and RMSE must be below that target's lower pixel reading, rescaled in STD by finite-M iid theory for the small actual-span difference. These are pointwise engineering checks, not a simultaneous confidence claim or author-statistic identification.
frontend.linearization: Use the actual edge-time errors and local noiseless period to predict frequency deviations to first order; preserve their joint dependence. Compare against an independence surrogate that keeps marginal edge variances but removes covariance. Relative STD agreement tolerance 2 percent for actual timing-error projection.

bench.note: Separate constant-amplitude, iid timing-jitter test with random initial clock phase and actual ceil quantization. No FID decay or physical clock drift. Sweep sub-LSB carrier positions so rounding cannot hide noise. SNR of the paper's bench is unspecified.
